text:
maria: Heads-up: product wants a safer fallback UX when v2 rejects requests due to strict schema/format changes. They want a console banner + automatic v1 fallback option, but we need to talk telemetry and quota semantics. Thoughts?

oliver: Agree we need something. My main worry: silent fallbacks hide regressions. We should emit clear telemetry and a rate-limited banner in the console. :warning:

sasha: +1. Telemetry needs to show 'fallback reason' (schema|model-mismatch|timeout) and whether fallback was auto-allowed. Suggest events: `api.v2.fallback_attempt`, `api.v2.fallback_success`, tags: model_version, customer_id, fallback_mode.

anya: For quotas — if a request hits v2 but falls back to v1, which quota bucket do we charge? Hosted customers will be confused if v2 tokens are billed differently. IMO charge based on final model served and include a dimension for "requested_api_version" so we can reconcile.

maria: Good point. Product's ask was: keep customer experience seamless (auto fallback on minor incompatibilities) but clearly call out in billing/usage UI. Can we add a per-request header like `x-redwood-final-version`?

oliver: We already add `x-redwood-model` for model runtime. Adding `x-redwood-final-version` is cheap. We also need a flag so Console can show a deprecation badge when > 5% of traffic is falling back.

sasha: Implementation note: runtime routing supports policy-based fallthrough today: `policy: strict|lenient|allow_v1_fallback`. Default v2 rollout plan uses `strict` for first 2 weeks, then `lenient`. We can extend to `allow_v1_fallback` with an audit log entry. Example config: 

```
routing:
  version: v2
  fallback_policy: allow_v1_fallback
  fallback_audit: true
```
But need to gate with an enterprise flag (security teams will want explicit opt-in).

anya: For telemetry, let's keep counters and sampled traces. Counters: fallback_attempt_total, fallback_success_total. Traces: capture input hash + diff summary (no raw PII). Also surface a dashboard in Console: by route -> fallback rate, top reasons, customer impact (latency change).

maria: UX ask from product: show an inline banner in route detail with text like: "Some requests are served by v1 due to incompatibilities — see details" with link to last 24h examples. Banner should be dismissible for org-admins for 24h.

oliver: Dismissible sounds fine. We should also surface a recommended remediation: "enable compatibility shim" or "pin model version v2.0.1". We must avoid encouraging disabling protections without context.

sasha: Security: if fallback exposes different tokens or KMS zones, block automatic fallback. So runtime needs a policy check: fallback_allowed_if_same_tenant_and_kms.

maria: Action items I see: 1) runtime: add `fallback_policy=allow_v1_fallback` + header `x-redwood-final-version` + audit log (oliver) 2) telemetry: instrument events/counters + dashboard (sasha) 3) billing: charge final model and add reconciliation dimension (anya) 4) product: banner text & dismiss behavior (maria) 5) security: gate fallback for cross-kms/tenants (sasha/oliver)

anya: I'll draft the billing reconciliation doc and example queries. Quick example for BigQuery: 

```
SELECT
  requested_version,
  final_version,
  SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE event_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE()
GROUP BY requested_version, final_version
```
maria: Perfect. Can we aim to ship a canary for `allow_v1_fallback` behind a feature flag for 10% of orgs next week? Need eng-estimates.

oliver: I'll do runtime changes and a safe default (off). Estimate 3 dev-days + 1 day for tests + deploy job. Can do canary after that.

sasha: I'll add telemetry events and a basic Console dashboard card. Estimate 2 dev-days.

anya: Billing doc + UI mapping — I can get a spike done in 2 days.

maria: OK — thanks team. I'll sync with product about banner language and legal compliance. @deploy-bot please create a canary rollout ticket when oliver is ready. :+1:

deploy-bot: Created ticket RW-5432: "canary rollout: v2 allow_v1_fallback feature flag" — assigned to oliver, milestone next-sprint.

oliver: Got it. Will post a short RFC with config examples and migration plan this week.

maria: Great — closing the loop here. If anyone thinks silent fallback should be disabled by default for all orgs, call it out in the RFC. :eyes:
